source_digest_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted src/open_painter/**/*.py POSIX relative paths followed by exact file bytes
measurement_limits: These are component and completed Canvas/engine callbacks, not whole-application input-to-display latency or viewport FPS.
Spatial variants use frozen Round4 Canvas/Surface/reach code and current Device in the same process; this isolates the spatial change.
State-cache timing compares the boolean off/on on identical final source with alternating pair order and completed, identical reset history.

The initial CPU spatial probe measures the bounds index before the sparse lookup follow-up; the packed-half probe precedes allocation-failure cleanup. Their algorithm and scope are separately identified.
All final GPU timing source hashes match the source_sha256 above; intermediate final-source predecessors are preserved in ignored raw artifacts.
Full checksums run outside timed engine interactions; a small image atlas provides timed GPU completion. Canvas uses a point completion fence.
State-cache timing results are mixed; fewer signature checks are not presented as a general end-to-end latency improvement.
Cold setup and first-dab timings are retained and are not included in warmed medians.

report.label: round5-state-cache-24-final2
report.measurement: engine evaluation then one sampled texel per image in an atlas and a single read; not viewport FPS
report.primary_metric: prepare_ms (addon callback work); completion_ms includes image GPU upload and fences
report.readback_accounting: engine metrics exclude benchmark completion and validation; both are reported
report.scheduler: timer disabled; explicit callback timing excludes its requested sleep

paired.order: off/on on even pairs; on/off on odd pairs
paired.reset: untimed completed target then initial edits before each variant; same measured transition
paired.validation: atlas equality per pair; full output equality after timing each stage

report.metric: Full Canvas.stamp + Canvas.publish callback, and callback plus one-texel GPU completion fence
report.limits: Excludes event dispatch, gesture ray casting, final document commit, preview graph evaluation and native viewport draw. Both variants use current Device/pool.
